target_customer: Software companies and security teams that need to find and fix vulnerabilities in their code
problem: Static scanners create noisy false positives and developers do not have time to triage and fix findings.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with a 14-day trial
product_category: AI application security (SAST and automated remediation)

founders.name: Ahmad Sadeddin
previous_startups: Previous startup acquired by Coupa (YC page says Corgea is his 3rd startup)
founders.background_notes: YC page: led Coupa's payments product, including its security, for three years. Sole founder per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating safe, correct code fixes with LLMs and cutting false positives needs careful validation, but it builds on existing models and scanner outputs.

defensibility.rationale: Scanner vendors (Snyk, Semgrep, GitHub) can add AI fixes on their own data; startup edge is speed and fix quality.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Snyk offers an AI fix feature (DeepCode AI Fix, later Agent Fix) and GitHub introduced Copilot Autofix in 2024 per search summaries of vendor pages; Corgea was still active and raising as of Nov 2024.

market_need_then: Security teams faced false-positive-heavy scanners; Corgea's customers cite fewer false positives (company claim). No dated 2023 demand source was gathered.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and results-focused with metric claims; no corgi imagery was confirmed from sources opened.

brand_strength.rationale: The name sounds like corgi but no source confirms a corgi mascot or brand intent; no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Corgea is active, named Zapier and Yageo as customers, and raised a $2.6M seed led by Shorooq Partners in November 2024. It has since broadened from code fixing to a full AI application security platform, including pentesting. The founder has said it is working toward Series A revenue goals, but no Series A, acquisition or layoff was found.
notes: Seed amount: most outlets $2.6M, a Zawya press release says $2.5M; $2.6M used. Some sources list $3.2M total raised; unverified. Competitors left empty: Snyk, Semgrep and Pixee evidence comes from 2024 to 2026 vendor pages. Founder education not found. The corgi mascot is not confirmed.
